detail.diagnosis: The fixed sticky-promo overlays and intercepts clicks on the fixed Add to Cart button

openWeight.rationale: Fix correctly addresses diagnosed overlay: add-to-cart at bottom:16px z-index:10 was covered by sticky-promo at bottom:0 height:84px z-index:20 (hitIsSelf=false, hitElement=sticky-promo). Moving to bottom:100px places button 16px above promo, preserving both elements. Evidence shows 3 interactive/pointer failures resolved (interactive-usable@mobile/small/desktop and pointer-purchase-works) with no new failures; remaining cart-total failures are pre-existing and unrelated.

detail.diagnosis: Cart total uses a stale legacy unit price instead of the catalog price for nova-sneaker

openWeight.rationale: Fix correctly replaces stale hardcoded LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR (7900) with product.priceMinor from window.CATALOG (8900), aligning cart calculation with catalog source of truth and screenshot ($89.00). Evidence shows totals now correctly 8900/17800 vs prior 7900/15800, clearing both failing signals with no hardcoded value and deterministic probe pass.
